molybdenum.sourceDataset: Australian Food Composition Database Release 3 (December 2025)
molybdenum.samplingDetails: The majority of nutrient data were derived from two analyses: (1) a composite of 5 samples of regular fat butter (1x Homebrand, 1x Western Star, 1x Mainland, 1x Devondale, 1x Black and Gold) purchased in five states across Australia in 2010, and (2) individual and composite analyses of 3 samples of butter (1x Devondale, 1x Woolworth's Select, 1x Black and Gold) purchased in four states across Australia in 2008. Vitamin E and retinol were determined by individual analyses of these 4 samples. Fatty acids were derived from individual analyses of 8 samples of regular fat butter (3x Coles, 2x Western Star, 1x Lurpak, 1x Kerrygold, 1x Devondale) purchased in four states across Australia in 2019. Protein, starch, vitamins (B1, B2, B3, B6, B12, C, cryptoxanthin, retinol), and minerals (Na, Pb, Se, Zn) were analysed in the 2010 samples only. Minerals (Al, As, Ca, Cd, Cr, Cu, Fe, Hg, K, Mn, Mo), lutein and lycopene were analysed in the 2008 samples only. Moisture and fat were also derived from 3 composite analyses of 6 samples of regular fat butter purchased in NSW, VIC and WA in 2018/19 (Dunlop et al., 2021). Vitamin D was derived from the 2018/19 samples only. Minerals (Ca, Cr, Fe, I, K, Mn, Mo, Ni, P, Se) were also derived from 3 composite samples of butter from SA, WA, and QLD in 2004; this is the only source of data for P. Minerals (F, Mg, S) and biotin were derived from an analysis of butter samples in 1990. Tryptophan was imputed from full fat milk. Alcohol, fibre and caffeine were imputed zero.
molybdenum.note: Direct measured profile for plain salted butter. The target does not specify salt, which does not materially change its trace mineral content.

Fat and fatty acids were derived in 3 brands of olive oil (1x Woolworths Homebrand, 1x Woolworths Homebrand Extra Virgin, 1x Minerva Greek) purchased in TAS and NSW in 2013. Alpha tocopherol and beta carotene were also derived from a composite of 10 samples of olive oil (5x Cobram Estate, 2x Squeaky Gate, 1x Red Island, 1x Kangaroo Island, 1x Rosto) purchased in three states across Australia in 2022 (Dunlop et al., 2022).
